Quick Actions

The two settings you are most likely to use.

Backup & Recovery Local + cloud recovery

Save or restore the campaign stored on this device. Full cloud disaster backups are DM-only and are intended for emergencies.

Local Campaign Backup

Cloud Disaster Recovery

Creates a complete Supabase campaign-data backup, including trainers, Pokémon, campaign state, Pokédex, messages, and battle history.

Cloud Sync & Migration DM only

Use these only when intentionally replacing the cloud campaign with this device, or replacing this device with the cloud copy.

Advanced Maintenance Usually not needed

Backup Check

Confirms that the current device's persistent campaign data is included in local backups.

Map Image Cache

Images preload automatically. Use this only if a map or badge image is missing.
